title: Route 53
explanation: Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable DNS web service. It performs three main functions: domain registration, DNS routing, and health checking. It supports multiple routing policies for traffic management.
analogy: Route 53 is like the phone book of the internet — when someone dials a name (domain), it looks up the correct number (IP address) and connects the call.
keyPoints: Supports routing policies: simple, weighted, latency-based, failover, geolocation, multi-value, and geoproximity
Health checks can monitor endpoints and trigger DNS failover
Alias records map to AWS resources without additional charges for queries

examKeywords.definition: AWS managed DNS service providing domain registration, DNS routing with multiple policies, and health checking with 100% availability SLA.

commonMistakes: Not using alias records for AWS resources — they are free and resolve faster
Confusing latency-based routing (performance) with geolocation routing (compliance/localization)
